title: Enhancing Multiple Dimensions of Trustworthiness in LLMs via Sparse Activation Control
reasoning: The paper evaluates and seeks to enhance Large Language Model trustworthiness across dimensions including 'Preference Bias' and 'Safety.' It specifically examines and benchmarks the model's ability to remain neutral or avoid taking 'ethical or moral stances' on controversial topics and compares automated benchmark performance with human evaluation of alignment to human values.
